text: Tadhg's driving test is Thursday at 10am. Third attempt, he's properly nervous this time. Text him good luck the night before.
Joanna invited us to her housewarming sometime next week, she'll confirm the day. New place is in Leith, two bed, garden.
ming results day thurs morning. mum says she hasnt slept
Fiona's 40th dinner is the 12th at half 7, the Italian on Church St. Her husband Graham is organising, said no presents but she's been eyeing up a Le Creuset casserole dish for months.
Remind me to call Eduardo the day after his audition for the Royal Northern, it's Monday afternoon.
Afua passed her theory test!! First go. Practical booked for early March.
Ava's party is off, her dad's back in hospital. Check in with her over the weekend.
Jakub and his partner Freya are having people round Saturday from 6 for Freya's birthday. I'm bringing dessert.
Pieter vegetarian, Florin doesn't eat pork. For the dinner on Friday.

So I just got off the phone with Farah and um she's got her bar exam results coming out end of the month and she's really not sure how it went, she said the second paper was a disaster. Her sister Layla got hers last year and passed so there's a bit of pressure there I think. I should send her something that evening whatever happens, maybe flowers if it's good news.
Femi got into the choir!
Bethany - grade 8 piano exam Wednesday at 2pm. Ask her how it went that evening.
Pick up dry cleaning tomorrow morning before 9.
Jack said Aditi's leaving do is Friday at the Crown from 5. Need to chip in for her card by Thursday.
neha struggling w revision, a levels start mid may. her mum on at her constantly. pop round w snacks sometime next week
Dalia's dog Biscuit had his op this morning, all went fine. She's taking him home tomorrow.
Malik - wife Hannah expecting in the spring, first one. Works at the council in planning. Big Celtic fan.
Victor's MOT is due over the summer, not my problem but he asked me to remind him. Text Victor in June.
Imogen's engagement party, Saturday 3pm, her parents' house in Harrogate. Dress code smart casual. Taking the train up that morning.

Fatima's son Hamza has his 11+ on the 14th, the morning one at 9. She's more stressed than he is honestly, been up at night going through practice papers with him. Hamza seemed totally chill when I saw him, mostly talked about Minecraft. Results come out sometime in October. She asked if I'd sit with her that morning while he's in.
Message Jasmine the week after her nursing exams to see if she wants to celebrate. Exams finish the 22nd.
Graham hates surprise parties. Don't let Fiona's sister plan one.
Camila and Santiago's anniversary dinner is next Tuesday at 8, they've asked us along. Ten years! Get them a card.

Eamon's uncle passed away last week, very sudden, heart attack. Funeral is sometime early next month in Galway, they're waiting on the date. He's flying over with his brother Tadhg and staying with their aunt for a few days after. He sounded flat on the phone, said work has been a nightmare on top of it. Send a card to his house this week.
Note to self: book my own driving test, aim for end of November.
Did Joanna's housewarming happen? Think it was last Saturday. Ask her how it went and if the boiler got sorted.
Chatted with Ming after class. She's thinking of applying to vet school, loves horses, rides every Sunday.
Eduardo got the part!! Rehearsals start in January. Must send congrats tonight.
Fiona said Afua's mum is having a hip replacement on Tuesday morning. Afua's driving her in.

ok so Ava rang, she's doing her ACCA paper on the 9th at 9am and then her cousin's wedding is that same weekend, the 11th, in Bristol. Said she'll be knackered. Message her the evening of the 9th and remind me about the wedding gift by the 1st.

Jakub's stag do is mid-April in Krakow, three nights, and I've said I'm in. Freya's hen is the weekend after in Brighton. Wedding itself is the 30th of May at 2pm, at her family's farm outside York. Busy spring for them. Freya says they've barely started the seating plan and her mum keeps adding people.

Pieter MacDonald, Florin's boss, met him at the barbecue. Really nice actually, not what I expected from the way Florin talks about him. Runs half marathons, training for Berlin next September. Two teenage boys, one of them doing his GCSEs this year. Wife's called Hannah, she's a GP. Said we should all go for dinner sometime.
Farah's mum's 70th is next Sunday at lunchtime. Farah asked if I could make a cake. Said yes. Need to buy ingredients Saturday.
Femi Adeyemi aka Fem - new guy on the five-a-side team. Studying engineering at Strathclyde, has a cat called Mango.
Bethany's driving test got cancelled again, examiner off sick. Rebooked for sometime next week, she's gutted.
Text Jack good luck Friday morning, his job interview at Deloitte is at 11.
Groceries, bin day Wednesday, renew passport before the summer.
Aditi and her husband are hosting Diwali dinner on the 1st at 7. Their kids are doing a dance. Bring sweets, nothing with nuts, little one's allergic.
Neha got her results this morning, three As and a B. Over the moon. She's off to Leeds in September.

Dalia nervous about her presentation to the board tomorrow at 2. It's the big one, the restructure proposal she's been working on since the summer, and her boss is apparently going to be grilling her in front of everyone. She's barely eating. Remind me to text her at lunchtime, then again that evening to see how it went.
Malik's brother Victor is moving to Manchester end of the month. Leaving drinks Thursday night, I said I'd go.
Hannah had the baby! Girl, Saturday night, 7lb 2. Malik sounds wrecked but happy. Send a gift next week once they're home.

Imogen's cello recital is the 18th at half 6 at the music college. Her teacher says she's ready but she keeps saying she'll freeze, apparently it happened at her last one in the spring and she's never got over it. She's playing the Elgar. Her grandparents are coming down from Aberdeen for it. Get a ticket before they sell out.
hamza theory test fri 4pm. fatima wants me to take him bc she's working. i'm picking him up from school at 3
Jasmine Kaur — Jas — met at Eduardo's dinner. Teaches Year 6, lives in Didsbury, obsessed with sourdough.
Graham's knee is bad again, physio twice a week now. He's not coping well with not running.
Remind me to ring Camila the day before Santiago's citizenship test, she wanted help with his flashcards. Test is the 20th, morning.
Eamon said his daughter's starting uni in Dundee over the summer, they're driving her up in late August. He's dreading the empty house.
Tadhg failed. Text him later, not now.

Weird call with Joanna this afternoon. She said the dinner she was hosting for her in-laws on Saturday is cancelled, her and Pieter split up on Sunday. She's staying at her sister's for a bit. Didn't say much else. I should check in tomorrow evening and maybe take her out for lunch sometime next week, just us.
Ming's sister Afua? No — Ming's sister is Aditi. Aditi's PhD viva is early December. Ming says she's terrified.
Florin's birthday is the 3rd. Wants vinyl, specifically anything by Fleetwood Mac he doesn't already have.
Dinner at Farah's tonight 7:30, bring wine.
Femi and Bethany are throwing a joint graduation party, Saturday the 5th at 8 at Femi's flat. Everyone's invited. Don't forget to get them both something small.
Jack's grandad is 90 on Friday. Whole family going for afternoon tea at 3. Jack wants to frame an old photo for him.
Aditi Patel, neighbour at number 12. Two kids, dog called Rolo, works nights at the Royal.
Neha's mum asked if I'd come to the parents' evening thing on Thursday at 6 since her dad's away. Said I would.
Going to the gym 7am tomorrow, then dentist at 11.

Victor's daughter has her ballet exam end of the month, then a show over Christmas. He asked me to remind him to order the costume the week before the exam. Also his wife's birthday is around then, the 28th I think. Ask him what she'd like.
Nice catch-up with Layla. Nothing much new. She's still at the bank, still hates the commute.
